shill: Add mockable keyword In general, the virtual keyword is used for methods that are going to be mocked, even if those methods should not be inherited by non-mock children. This works fine for projects that have a flat or very simple inheritance hierarchy. Shill, however, has neither of those, and the most complex inheritance hierarchies (e.g. the Service and Device hierarchies) become much more difficult to read and understand when one is never sure if a virtual method is used just for mocks or is also overridden by children. This change creates a separate 'mockable' keyword for methods that should only be overridden by mocks. The 'mockable' behavior is enforced by being #defined to virtual only in test builds. BUG=chromium:997295 TEST=None. FROMGIT: firmware: google: check if size is valid when decoding VPD data The VPD implementation from Chromium Vital Product Data project used to parse data from untrusted input without checking if the meta data is invalid or corrupted. For example, the size from decoded content may be negative value, or larger than whole input buffer. Such invalid data may cause buffer overflow. To fix that, the size parameters passed to vpd_decode functions should be changed to unsigned integer (u32) type, and the parsing of entry header should be refactored so every size field is correctly verified before starting to decode. BUG=chromium:967209 TEST=emerge-kukui chromeos-kernel-4_19 Fixes: ad2ac9d5c5e0 ("firmware: Google VPD: import lib_vpd source files") Signed-off-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <linux@roeck-us.net> Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org> Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20190830022402.214442-1-hungte@chromium.org Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> (cherry picked from commit 4b708b7b1a2c09fbdfff6b942ebe3a160213aacd git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/char-misc.git char-misc-next) Change-Id: Iebc51abeba143719d0bb55e78e9048aca559c3b8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1795465 Tested-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>

update_sku: Support OEM_ID as an optional CBI field OEM ID has been moved out of the required fields in CBI. So the OEM_ID check in update_sku.py should be adjusted as follows to support the boards with or without OEM ID. (a) If both cros_config and eeprom have no oem id: OEM ID check PASSES (because this board doesn't support OEM ID). (b) If one of cros_config and eeprom has oem id: OEM ID check FAILS. (c) If both cros_config and eeprome have oem id, and oem ids match: OEM ID check PASSES. (d) If both cros_config and eeprome have oem id but oem ids mismatch: OEM ID check FAILS. UPSTREAM: ath6kl: add some bounds checking The "ev->traffic_class" and "reply->ac" variables come from the network and they're used as an offset into the wmi->stream_exist_for_ac[] array. Those variables are u8 so they can be 0-255 but the stream_exist_for_ac[] array only has WMM_NUM_AC (4) elements. We need to add a couple bounds checks to prevent array overflows. I also modified one existing check from "if (traffic_class > 3) {" to "if (traffic_class >= WMM_NUM_AC) {" just to make them all consistent.
